title: Bind one typed Item placement-clear intent and dispatch the verified clear operation

requirements.invariant: Clearing intends to replace one Item's optional current Space placement with no Space and remains distinct from destination assignment. Every candidate must carry stable identity, exact revision and caller-supplied current-Space conflict evidence. Nil/no-current-Space intent is structurally unrepresentable and creates no synthetic no-op receipt; stale assigned-looking evidence may dispatch and later conflict.

One explicit nonempty clear may contain candidates naming different current Spaces, but one exact Account and Project-or-Business-Inventory scope binds the complete selection. Exact caller-supplied Item revision/current-Space preconditions support later atomic and idempotent authoritative application; typed local values do not prove actual placement, membership or authorization.

Clearing placement changes organizational state only. A later trusted handler derives closure of affected green Item-linked photo-checkmark relationships from authoritative state without deleting photos or bytes. The client submits no attachment reference, marker list, review-note evidence, accounting or provenance value.

ItemSpaceClearingIntent is transient and non-Codable with exactly AccountID, ItemPlacementScope and typed ItemSpaceClearingCandidate values. It owns no destination, nullable field, alternate validator, Item selection/readiness/UI eligibility, route, backend path, media/marker, provider identity or authorization claim.

ItemSpaceClearingUseCase binds the exact typed Account/scope/candidates through ItemSpaceClearingDraft and ClearItemSpaceAssignmentsCommand construction before invoking ItemSpaceAssignmentClearing.clearItemSpaceAssignments exactly once, then validates and returns the exact receipt and LocalOperationState.

The use case preserves CancellationError and every one of the 15 ItemSpaceClearingFailure values thrown by the port. Only an unknown port error maps to localAcceptanceFailed; construction remains outside the port catch and receipt validation remains outside it.

The verified clearing operation remains sole owner of canonical nonempty duplicate-free Item/revision/current-Space input, mixed-current-Space evidence handling, internally consistent exact scope/revision/current-placement preconditions, deterministic ordering, operation envelope, subject, fingerprint, receipt validation and all 15 ItemSpaceClearingFailure values. These are untrusted conflict claims until a trusted handler validates actual state. This use case composes rather than reimplements or extends them.

Only the two new target leaves advance. Verified dependencies SWIFT-4C7158974133/TEST-0AB198EB6935 and sibling assignment/use-case/destination leaves SWIFT-4B007A00C393/TEST-51D893DD949E/SWIFT-0540BE125F5A/TEST-DA67EAC9C2EF/SWIFT-164554FA1456/TEST-A3D73145E3EC stay verified and unchanged. Clear-space source surfaces SWIFT-0B434663295C, SWIFT-4C8A8E236450, SWIFT-BDF8928A5FC7, SWIFT-DDFAC91775DA, SWIFT-AB578AEF4330, SWIFT-F3BDD0968C6D, SWIFT-236679C7D427, SWIFT-C593225376EB, TEST-8B555E151D8D, MCPMOD-82DC4C25B1B8 stay characterized; SWIFT-4D0D546A02D, SWIFT-C0ABD9666AE7, SWIFT-47AEDE21C63C, TEST-6297E07C65AA, TEST-C1A3D3DA5E75, MCPMOD-155A4AB80AC9 stay target_mapped. Each owns broader read, UI, service, marker, persistence, test, or integration behavior.

Exactly two target-only executable leaves may change after READY. Archive/O-037, attachment reference or byte deletion/O-023, unassigned/no-op policy, Item read/UI eligibility, marker mutation, physical persistence, optimistic projection, trusted authorization/audit/apply, Postgres/Data API/RLS/PowerSync/provider behavior, app/MCP wiring, source migration, hosted resources, production, release and cutover do not advance.

items: ItemSpaceClearingIntent is public, transient and non-Codable with exactly AccountID, ItemPlacementScope and typed ItemSpaceClearingCandidate values.

The use case reuses the verified ItemSpaceClearingDraft, ClearItemSpaceAssignmentsCommand and ItemSpaceAssignmentClearing port; construction binds the exact Account/scope and canonical caller-supplied conflict candidates before exactly one port call without proving actual placement or authorization.
Receipt validation follows the port boundary; all 15 operation failures and Swift cancellation remain exact, and only unknown port errors are bounded.

Nil/no-current-Space intent is structurally unrepresentable, empty selection rejects, no synthetic no-op receipt exists, and stale assigned-looking evidence may dispatch for later authoritative conflict. Mixed assigned/unassigned admission/filtering, Item selection/readiness/UI eligibility, destination assignment, archive, attachment/byte deletion, marker mutation, scope movement, accounting and provenance policy remain outside.

The deterministic in-memory clearer cannot physically persist, authorize, synchronize, close or delete markers/media, mutate accounting/provenance, deploy, display, migrate, release or cut over a clear.

verification.expected: A non-@testable consumer constructs the exact public three-field ItemSpaceClearingIntent. It is compile-time Equatable/Sendable, runtime non-Codable, preserves Project and Business Inventory scope plus boundary Item revision/current-Space values, and exposes no destination, null field, read/UI, media/marker, provider or accounting field.

Project and Business Inventory input dispatch exactly once. The exact Account and scope bind only their command/draft/envelope/subject/scope-precondition fields, while one Item and mixed-current-Space bulk candidates preserve each literal Item ID, boundary revision and current Space.

Differently ordered equivalent mixed-current-Space candidate input reaches one identical canonical command/fingerprint after one call. Zero and UInt64.max Item revisions remain exact, stale assigned-looking evidence may dispatch for later authoritative conflict, and no marker/media/accounting value is accepted or derived by the use case.

Empty or duplicate Item input and positive infinity/negative infinity/NaN capture time fail during draft/command construction with zero calls. Nil/no-current-Space intent is structurally unrepresentable and no synthetic no-op receipt exists; the use case does not claim an Item is actually assigned.

Every LocalOperationState returns in the exact validated receipt after exactly one call carrying the verified clear payload and preconditions; a mismatched receipt fails after exactly one call without any physical placement, marker or accounting claim.

A reciprocal flattened encoded-leaf matrix independently varies Account, Project-versus-Inventory scope, every Item ID/revision/current Space, Operation, actor, contract and time against literal baseline and exact changed-leaf expectations. Helpers must not reconstruct expectations through ItemSpaceClearingDraft, ClearItemSpaceAssignmentsCommand or production validation.

All 15 ItemSpaceClearingFailure values deliberately thrown by the port remain exact after one call, CancellationError remains structured cancellation, and only an unknown port error maps to localAcceptanceFailed. Construction and receipt failures remain outside the port catch.

All 15 diagnostic codes remain exact privacy-safe values, and exact intent/nested-command topology exposes only authorized clear draft/envelope/subject/fingerprint plus scope/Item revision/current-Space preconditions—never destination/archive/attachment/marker/scope-movement/accounting/provenance/UI/service/provider/credential/production fields.
